variants.displayName: Alliance Aid: Large Supply of Research Resource
variants.briefing:
To all available contractors,

Rayari needs your assistance. As part of the Alliance Aid effort, our scientists have shifted their entire focus to assisting Levski deal with Molina mold. Unfortunately, the team’s progress has stalled due to a lack of a key resource.

Obtaining it from our regular distributors could take weeks. Considering how many people desperately need help, stopping research for that long would seriously impact our effort. We’re hoping to find motivated individuals willing to procure and deliver a small scale haul of it for delivery to [Destination]. 

If you need help locating this resource, I suggest checking the 'Forager's Guide' in your mobiGlas Journal for more information.

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted. 

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

variants.briefing:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are working around-the-clock to assist with the treatment for the current fungal outbreak in Levski. Due to logistic issues, our team at [Destination] is running low on a key resource in their research. Losing production at that location would hamper the Alliance Aid’s effort to cure people suffering from this terrible affliction in a timely manner.

That’s why we're eager for the help of anyone who can find and deliver this vital supply to [Destination].

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
